title: Data Masking Middleware
description: Data masking functions integrated into permission engine to protect buyer/tenant contact information for FREE package agents. Implements canSeeBuyerPhone permission and masking utilities for phone numbers and names based on agent subscription package.
features: maskName() utility: Hides middle characters (e.g., R****a S****a)
Applied to leads endpoint in agent routes
Applied to appointments endpoint in agent routes
Preserves first 2 and last 2 digits for phone verification
Preserves first and last characters for name recognition
Automatic masking based on agent package
No changes needed in controller logic
acceptance_criteria: FREE agents cannot see full buyer phone
PRO+ agents can see full buyer phone
Masking applied to leads API response
Masking applied to appointments API response
Masking functions work with E.164 format
result_summary: Complete data masking implementation in permission engine. FREE agents see masked buyer phone (+91-XXXXX-XXX10) and names (R****a S****a) while PRO+ agents see full details. Automatic masking based on package subscription. Production-ready for marketplace privacy control.
